title: A worker that declares nothing on a CPU slower than the reference, or on SMT threads, counts more than it holds: a play it cannot keep is admitted and stalls, where a declared worker refuses with a reason
notes: A redesigned measurement must never delay registration, never slow a film being watched, keep its figure within a stated margin on a busy host, and be shown on a 4-process, 4-CPU run before it merges. Promote on any of: the assumed-capacity slow reason counted on any deployment; JS-166 criterion 9 showing a declared figure wrong by more than a fifth; JS-056 starting (the example manifests' default must then be right); an issue carrying such a log line. Promoted into JS-177 (D-064); its four bars are JS-177 criteria 2 to 4.
